cases.text: Short string: fast swings, lower v
Long string: slow swings, higher v

changes: Chose side-by-side layout with 3-row columns text arrangement so all 3 explanation lines, formula, and 3 values fit cleanly.
Mapped main stage to pxPerUnit 60 and originPx [164, 72] so pendulum swing, references, and bob fit within 304 x 260.8 px.
Set vel_arrow lengthFactor to 1.8 and startAtEdge to true so the arrowhead clears the large bob at all string lengths.
Placed vel_arrow label v below the arrow so it stays clear of the bob, string, and vertical reference.
Shortened release_label to 60 deg symbol and placed it above-right of release_ref so it stays inside the stage at max length.
Disabled the coordinate-plot title so the plot with legend fits the 260.8 px height and keeps the Reset button clear.
Shortened value labels Small-angle to Small-ang and Peak speed to Peak v to fit the 200 px values column.
Dropped the fourth value (Angle) because the 3-row column holds at most 3 values and angle is shown in the plot.
